meta_description: Adstyle Decorators in Newcastle offer interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed. Call today.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with precision painting and decorating across Newcastle. Free quotes, no mess, professional finish guaranteed.
services_subhead: From interior walls and feature rooms to external repaints and protective coatings, we handle every decorating job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Expert interior redecoration including walls, ceilings, woodwork, and doors. We prepare surfaces properly and use premium paints for a finish that lasts years.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior repaints, render finishing, and protective coatings for fascias and soffits. We work to exacting standards in all Newcastle weather conditions.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Pattern matching, bespoke feature walls, and full room wallpapering. We handle tricky corners and slopes without bubbles or seams showing.

services.title: Furniture & Cabinet Painting
services.desc: Kitchen cabinet respray, furniture makeovers, and custom finishes. Transform tired units into statement pieces without the cost of replacement.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality redecorating. We work flexibly to minimise disruption and meet strict commercial finish standards.

services.title: Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Thorough surface prep, crack repair, plasterboard patching, and woodwork treatment. A solid foundation ensures your new finish lasts longer.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own home — that's why customers come back.
about_para_1: Adstyle Decorators was founded on a simple principle: deliver honest, quality work at fair prices. Over 12 years, we've built a loyal client base across Newcastle through reliability and attention to detail. Whether it's a single bedroom or a full commercial refit, we approach every project with the same level of care.
about_para_2: Customers choose us because we listen. We explain options clearly, turn up on time, and protect your home during the work. Our reputation is built on finished spaces that look beautiful and last — and word-of-mouth referrals from satisfied homeowners across the city prove it works.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called Adstyle on a Tuesday afternoon needing the lounge redecorated before family visited. Mark arrived for a free quote the next morning and started work Friday. The quality is brilliant — crisp lines, no drips, proper prep work. Fair price too. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: Had our Victorian terrace exterior repainted — soffits, fascias, all the woodwork. Took real care protecting the garden and keeping mess minimal. Been done 18 months now and looks as good as day one. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Feature wall in our dining room turned out stunning. They matched the pattern perfectly where we had older wallpaper. Professional team, tidy workers, and finished bang on schedule. Great value for money.
reviews.author: Michael T.
